If the research question depends on the causal role of win-objective emphasis, this contamination is meaningful, though it does not undermine the fidelity of other variables or the core implementation of the rank-irrelevant payoff gradient. Hence, the simulation provides informative but partially contaminated evidence, warranting a 'slightly_valid' rating.
